error_codes.name: no_error
error_codes.description: No error occurred.

error_codes.name: regular_error
error_codes.description: Generic power grid error.

error_codes.name: batch_error
error_codes.description: Error occurs in batch calculation.

error_codes.name: serialization_error
error_codes.description: Error occurs during (de-)serialization.

error_codes.name: dataset_error
error_codes.description: Error occurs during dataset handling.

error_codes.name: data_error
error_codes.description: There was a problem with the contents of the provided data.

error_codes.name: conflict_id
error_codes.description: Conflicting IDs found.

error_codes.name: id_not_found
error_codes.description: A reference to a non-existent ID was provided.

error_codes.name: component_data_error
error_codes.description: A component data error was found.

error_codes.name: conflict_voltage
error_codes.description: There is a conflicting voltage.

error_codes.name: invalid_transformer_clock
error_codes.description: Invalid transformer clock found.

error_codes.name: invalid_short_circuit_phase_or_type
error_codes.description: Invalid (combination of) short circuit types and phase(s) provided.

error_codes.name: multi_component_data_error
error_codes.description: A data error was found that affects multiple components.

error_codes.name: id_wrong_type
error_codes.description: A referenced ID points to a component that cannot be referenced here.

error_codes.name: invalid_measured_object
error_codes.description: A provided measured object is invalid.

error_codes.name: invalid_regulated_object
error_codes.description: A provided regulated object is invalid.

error_codes.name: duplicatively_regulated_object
error_codes.description: A regulated object is regulated by multiple sources.

error_codes.name: conflicting_voltage_regulator_u_ref
error_codes.description: Conflicting voltage regulator Uref found.

error_codes.name: unsupported_voltage_regulator_source_combination
error_codes.description: Cannot regulate nodes with both a source and a voltage regulated load/generator.

error_codes.name: unsupported_data_error
error_codes.description: The base class for data errors that are a result of limitations of the power grid model, not unphysical data.

error_codes.name: conflicting_angle_measurement_type
error_codes.description: Different current angle measurement types on the same node are not supported.

error_codes.name: unsupported_regulator_combination
error_codes.description: The combination of voltage regulators and transformer tap regulators is not supported in the same model.

error_codes.name: unsupported_load_gen_type_for_voltage_regulator
error_codes.description: Unsupported load_gen type for voltage regulators.

error_codes.name: calculation_error
error_codes.description: Error occurs during the actual calculation.

error_codes.name: sparse_matrix_error
error_codes.description: Attempting to invert a non-invertible matrix.

error_codes.name: iteration_diverge
error_codes.description: Unable to iteratively converge to an optimum within the set number of iterations and precision.

error_codes.name: not_observable
error_codes.description: Attempting to solve a non-observable system.

error_codes.name: max_iteration_reached
error_codes.description: Maximum number of iterations reached.

error_codes.name: automatic_tap_input_error
error_codes.description: Automatic tap changer attempts to control the source side for automatic tap changing calculation.

error_codes.name: illegal_operation
error_codes.description: An illegal operation was attempted to the C API, such as accessing a null pointer.

error_codes.name: bad_request
error_codes.description: A bad request was attempted to the C API, such as providing the wrong dataset type.

error_codes.name: experimental_feature
error_codes.description: An experimental feature was used but experimental features are not enabled.

error_codes.name: invalid_arguments
error_codes.description: A (combination of) input arguments is not valid.

error_codes.name: invalid_calculation_method
error_codes.description: Invalid calculation method provided.

error_codes.name: not_implemented
error_codes.description: The functionality is either not supported or not yet implemented.

error_codes.name: internal_error
error_codes.description: There was an internal error.

error_codes.name: unreachable_hit
error_codes.description: Supposedly unreachable code was hit. This is always a bug in PGM. Please file a bug report.

error_codes.name: tap_search_strategy_incompatible
error_codes.description: Search method is incompatible with optimization strategy.

error_codes.name: unknown_error
error_codes.description: An unknown error occurred.
